packageRules.description: Angular pins the toolchain it compiles with: @angular/build and @angular/compiler-cli 22 declare `typescript: >=6.0 <6.1` as a peer dependency, and the examples and the preview share the workspace's TypeScript. A major bump is not an upgrade until Angular moves; minor and patch updates still flow.
@types/node follows the oldest Node.js the packages support (engines: ^22.22.3), not the newest: types for a later Node would let code compile that fails on 22.
One pull request for Tailwind CSS: tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss and @tailwindcss/vite are released together and the style package's tests compile with them.
